fields.title: BM25 ranking
fields.content: BM25 ranks documents with term frequency saturation and document length normalization. Configure k1 to control saturation and b to control length normalization.

fields.title: TF-IDF ranking
fields.content: TF-IDF combines term frequency with inverse document frequency. Rare terms contribute more than terms found throughout the collection.

fields.title: Field weighting
fields.content: Give concise title matches more influence than body matches by setting a larger per-field weight in the index schema.

fields.title: Filters and facets
fields.content: Structured filters narrow candidate documents with equals, ranges, membership, and existence operators. Facets count matching values after filtering.

fields.title: Trie autocomplete
fields.content: Autocomplete descends a Trie prefix subtree and orders vocabulary terms using document frequency. It does not scan the full term dictionary.

fields.title: Typo tolerance and spelling
fields.content: Levenshtein edit distance matches conservative fuzzy candidates. Spell correction retries only a zero-result query with a confident vocabulary correction.

fields.title: Index documents with the API
fields.content: Add one document or send a bounded bulk request. External identifiers make document ingestion idempotent because a repeated identifier updates the stored document.

fields.title: TypeScript SDK
fields.content: The official Seekr client provides typed indexes, documents, search, autocomplete, recommendation, and analytics methods with AbortSignal and structured errors.

fields.title: Scoped API keys
fields.content: API keys belong to one project. Grant only the search, document, index, or analytics scopes required by the client and rotate expiring credentials.

fields.title: Crawl a documentation site
fields.content: The crawler respects robots policy, domain boundaries, delays, response limits, redirects, and DNS private-network protection before extracting readable content.

fields.title: Hybrid recommendations
fields.content: Hybrid recommendation combines normalized content similarity, collaborative interaction neighbors, popularity, and recency without calling an embedding service.

fields.title: Create and restore snapshots
fields.content: A Seekr snapshot stores immutable segments and a checksum for every file. Restore validates into staging before replacing the target index.
